rules.summary: External data may be used to develop/test submissions if publicly/equally accessible at no cost or satisfying the stated reasonableness criteria. This original is public and CC0.

feature_duplicate_method: Read all common features with pandas float_precision=round_trip, identical dtypes and competition feature order. Exclude all IDs and labels. Compute pandas row hashes without index, then verify every candidate by exact merge on all 24 columns; report counts only.

identifiers_and_labels.note: A numeric overlap between different ID columns is not an established identity mapping. No labels were transferred or looked up for competition test rows; feature overlap counts do not expose row IDs.

findings: No feature-exact duplicate or feature-hash overlap exists among the original, competition train and competition test under the documented canonical parsing.
No competition-ID identity mapping is established; matching integers in the two differently named ID columns have zero rows equal across all 24 features.
All competition feature values are within original numeric ranges, but important upper tails are narrower in competition data. This is a distribution difference, not proof of a generator.
Individual numeric values often recur: original support covers 97.362992 percent of training amounts, 84.832562 percent of balances, 99.562546 percent of hours, and 99.536688 percent of distances.
There is no original-label lookup opportunity established for complete competition rows. Training on licensed public original labels remains distinct from using unknown competition test labels.
Current external GPT2 predictions already declare adaptation on this original, so an additional original-only score may be redundant; improvement is unmeasured.
